searchText: This is the eip-1559 chain? A testnet only What is the latest block height on the testnet? It is 158,595 http://3.21.227.120:3001/ I think we can add your node to ethstats. If <@!552133098075193354> and <@!574864862338088960> don't mind it I will send you ethstats config here we have useful links: https://github.com/ConsenSys/eip1559-rhodes (block explorer, toolbox, ethstats) Its gonna be a minute I had to restart the node a couple of times. I think I am getting the latest blocks though. Just behind on processing? I also have two peers I'm cool with this. I'll probably need some help making sure it is set up right <@!187490121698770945> Unfortunately, the processing is extremely slow on this chain. It takes about 2 days to process all blocks. I'll get there eventually. 🦾 Am I still propagating transactions? New ones I mean Almost to 666 <:mojodEvil:716971357942054912> @James visit Kenya with your mining machine with a GPU and engage in mining activities, since kenya is a developing country with mineral resources but with little technological know how? Am inviting you. does anyone know how to capture a smart contracts function call outputs using web3j I fixed the issues in the tool. Will do another session half an hour before our sync meeting I ran it 3 times in a row without issues. Basically when transaction pools are full transactions were dropped, meaning some gaps in nonces. To fix that I periodically retrieve the nonce for all accounts. No too frequently because there are 1000 accounts used for the tests. When is next sync meeting? are there EIPs describing changes to the transaction object format in JSON RPC? EIP-3041, EIP-3044, EIP-3045, EIP-3046 SendTransaction, GtTransactionByHash, etc.? I believe at the moment there are only 3041, 3044, 3045, 3046. There is a need for additional EIPs. Though, it is tough to write an EIP that modifies a specification that doesn't exist. 😉 Someone should try to coordinate various parties into speccing out the JSON-RPC. 😉 This friday 5.30 pm CET This will be my next job after performance test is done I will update all those EIPs to include the changes next week Here is a file with static node enode addresses of the testnet: https://github.com/ConsenSys/eip1559-rhodes/blob/main/static-nodes.json I added your Nethermind node <@!489256758989029405> <@!758579010027782144> . If you add more nodes please add them to this file What is CET? Sorry Central European Time equivalent to GMT+1 1 day, 2 hours, 50 minutes from now? Yes You want an invite ? That is pretty late to me... I may bow out of this one. Any expectation that questions will come up in the meeting around EIP-2718 integration? Not at all I've started a "proto-EIP" for the EIP-2930 changes, IMO we should tackle EIP-2930 before EIP-1559 since it's a) sooner (Berlin) b) simpler and c) sets the precedent for handling EIP-2718 txs going forward ; it also seems like a good test case for making sure that new functionality gets RPC consideration as early as possible. https://gist.github.com/ryanschneider/723d8e2bce0829de9d6beb43639b6d3e Happy to discuss more in <#779922457631916064> or <#804019759934078987> whichever you find more appropriate. I'm definitely willing to help usher this into a full EIP. Looking at the checklist for tomorrow, a few things that are still missing are: 1. Checking the connections between the various nodes on the network. It seems like all nodes have >4. Is that sufficient? 2. Nethermind confirming it can send + include both legacy and 1559-style txns 3. Nethermind having access to machine logs and be able to retrieve them when needed 4. Nethermind confirm that there are no disconnections between nodes when idle 5. Define progression levels for the testing procedure (at what gas levels we start) (cc: <@!574864862338088960>) 6. Confirm that the tx generator tool works ahead of the call (execute 2 - 3 blocks) (cc: <@!574864862338088960> ) I ran the second node, updated static_nodes, configure seq, and updated the check-list. The last thing for tomorrow is sending transactions. I made PR for static-nodes: https://github.com/ConsenSys/eip1559-rhodes/pull/4
